info.title: SDKWork RTC App API
info.description: App/client contract for SDKWork RTC session lifecycle, signaling, credential issue, callback mapping, recording artifacts, and provider health flows.

AuthToken.description: SDKWork auth token carried as Authorization: Bearer <auth_token>.

RtcOperationCommand.description: Operation-specific RTC command payload defined by the owning sdkwork-rtc Rust route/service module.
